_note: Source paths are relative to baselines/HITEC. 'code' = training/infer_training.py (released code). The released code wins over the paper.

max_sequence_tokens.source: BOS plus 1023 residues; model dimension equals the positional table length

scheduler.source: code training/infer_training.py:75-79 returns it under the key 'scheduler'. Lightning 2.6.1 reads only 'lr_scheduler', warns and ignores it.

loss.value: BCE with logits over observed entries, mean over observed entries

final_weights.value: SWA weights after the last epoch
final_weights.source: code training/infer_training.py:114 saves every epoch and selects none

batch_size.source: wrapper choice; the paper and code do not give it

num_workers.source: wrapper choice; loader order is seeded, so results do not change

sdpa.source: wrapper opt-in flag --sdpa; same function as the manual attention

seeds.source: wrapper default; the paper gives none

thresholds.value: per class, maximise F1 on the validation split; classes without observed or positive validation rows get 1.0
